source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 15.3.4 with Quick Check 15.4, printed pages 331-332.

items: Chromatography ki techniques organic synthesis (organic compounds banane) mein products ko alag karne, nikalne (isolation) aur saaf (purify) karne ke liye bohat mufeed hain. Yeh qualitative aur quantitative analysis mein aur kisi madde ki purity (khalis-pan) maloom karne mein bhi utni hi aham hain.
Chromatography dyes (rang), drugs (dawaiyan) aur pesticides (keeray maar dawaiyan) jaise pecheeda chemicals pehchanne ke liye bohat mufeed hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Paper chromatography mein mixture ke components kis bunyad par ek doosre se alag hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Har component stationary phase (kaghaz ke cellulose mein phansa pani) aur mobile phase (oopar chadhta organic solvent) ke darmiyan mukhtalif tarah bant-ta hai. Jo mobile phase mein zyada hal hota hai woh tez aur door jata hai; jo stationary phase se zyada chipakta hai woh peeche rehta hai. Is liye har component ki apni Rf value hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Paper chromatography mein stationary aur mobile phases kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Stationary phase: kaghaz ke cellulose fibers mein phansa hua pani. Mobile phase: kaghaz par oopar chadhne wala solvent, aam taur par organic liquid, jo is pani se nahi milta.

blocks.prompt: c) Paper chromatography se kisi madde ki purity kaise maloom ki jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Madde ka spot (saath pure known samples ke spots) laga kar chromatogram chalate hain. Pure madda sirf ek spot deta hai jis ki Rf pure sample jaisi ho; ek se zyada spots ka matlab hai madda impure hai.

blocks.prompt: Paper chromatography ke teen amali istemal batayein.
blocks.explanation: Organic synthesis ke product ki purity jaanchna (ek spot ya kai); syahi ya khane ke rang mein dyes ko known dyes se Rf mila kar pehchanna; sample mein drugs ya pesticides ka pata lagana.

items: Istemal: organic synthesis mein products alag karna, nikalna aur saaf karna; qualitative aur quantitative analysis; purity ki jaanch; dyes, drugs aur pesticides ki pehchan.
